extracted.name: Sugarless chocolate chip banana bread
extracted.description: Great recipe for Sugarless chocolate chip banana bread.
ingredient_lines: 3 overripe smashed bananas (make sure they are refrigerated)
instruction_lines: Separate the eggs and keep the egg whites aside.
Take the egg whites and beat them till you attain stiff peaks. Keep then aside.
Take a mixing bowl and add all the ingredients except chocolate chips and egg white and beat them with electric beater.
Once they have become cake batter consistency, fold the egg whites in this batter gradually.
Add chocolate chips and fold again and sprinkle some on top.
Take a bread pan and pour the batter and place it in the oven for 60 minutes. Take the bread out and let it cool for 10 minutes.
